properties.description: IOC issus du graphe Graph-RAG assaini pour APT29
properties.query:
union
(CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where SourceIP in ("203.0.113.77", "198.51.100.99") or DestinationIP in ("203.0.113.77", "198.51.100.99")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SourceIP, DestinationIP, Activity),
(DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Name in~ ("cdn-update.example.net", "wm-sync.example.org")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, Name),
(DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where SHA256 in~ ("f9babeebc604f41592b1906153661060a0062ba0edf62b33d813425dfa91b835", "2fe196a0e86c216e21b13770938da8af09fbf3149ff3591bb8b174301d4d036d")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, FileName, SHA256)
